items.summary:
SEOUL/SYDNEY, Nov 9 (Reuters) - Nvidia (NVDA.O) shares tumbled on Monday after an internal investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort ​put his future at the AI chipmaker under scrutiny. [...] Nvidia's shares tumbled around 8% in early trading, extending last week's selloff and pushing the stock to fresh multi-month lows. At the current levels, the chipmaker would lose around $350 billion in value from its last ​closing price.

"The market's probably telling you now this does no favors to the stock whatsoever in a time when there's a lot of conjecture as to the build-out of data centers," said Chris Weston, head of research at brokerage Pepperstone in ​Melbourne. [...] He is Nvidia's fifth-largest shareholder with a roughly 3.6% stake, according to LSEG data, and keeps a tight grip on the company through an unusually ​flat structure in which dozens of executives report directly to him.

But unlike Meta Platforms (META.O) or SpaceX (SPCX.O), Nvidia has no dual-class shares that would give its co-founder majority voting control.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admits affair, board to launch investigation
items.summary:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having a romantic relationship with a suspected Chinese spy in a message to his company, and the company's board announced an independent investigation Sunday.

Why it matters:The scandal raises national security concerns involving one of the world's most powerful tech CEOs, who has pushed to loosen restrictions on selling advanced AI chips to China amid the two countries' race for technological dominance. [...] "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did."
   Huang said he took "full responsibility" for his actions, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders.
   "Leading NVIDIA is the privilege of my life," Huang wrote. "I am fully committed to NVIDIA and will work to earn back your confidence." [...] Driving the news: "I owe my family and all of you an apology," Huang wrote in a draft email to Nvidia employees obtained by Axios.

items.title: Jensen Huang's affair highlights Nvidia's key man risk with no heir
items.summary:
Nvidia has long maintained a flat, non-hierarchical organizational structure. Huang has deep involvement in the company's day-to-day operations and frequently serves as its spokesperson in front of world leaders and at industry conferences. In addition to being co-founder and CEO, Huang is also Nvidia's president. [...] Nvidia's board "needs to demonstrate independence and protect shareholders without destabilizing a company whose success is unusually dependent on its founder," Schulze-Melander wrote. "Its initial statement suggests it is attempting to achieve both."

Several analysts said the investigation could lead to governance changes at Nvidia, including putting a transition contingency plan in place. [...] The Melius analysts wrote that Nvidia has a "strong bench" of executive talent across its networking, hyperscale and high-performance computing businesses, along with "technical expertise" stemming from Chief Technology Officer Michael Kagan as well as Dally, the chief scientist.

"While these folks can keep the engine running, Jensen is one of a kind, and his energy will be needed to maintain confidence in the AI trade," the analysts wrote.

items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon 今天从小范围试用走向公开入口。先别把“在 AI Studio 能用”理解成“免费档能用”：公告说的是付费 API 和 Ultra 订阅，不是向所有账号送免费额度。
items.summary:
Gemini 4 Carbon 今天从小范围试用走向公开入口。先别把“在 AI Studio 能用”理解成“免费档能用”：公告说的是付费 API 和 Ultra 订阅，不是向所有账号送免费额度。

这次新的是开放范围。Google 10 月 28 日先向部分网络安全防御团队放行；北京时间今晨 00:05 官方公开确认扩大开放。开发者在 AI Studio 用 API 付费层，Ultra 订阅者可在 Gemini App、搜索 AI Mode 和 Antigravity 陆续用上。看到入口仍没有 Carbon，不等于账号故障——公告说的是逐步推出。

真正值得算的是长期账单。公开版的介绍价为每百万输入 2 美元、输出 10 美元；11 月 30 日介绍期结束后，变成 4 / 20 美元。假设某批任务累计输入 100 万、输出 50 万 token，只按这两个单价估：现在 7 美元，之后 14 美元。缓存、工具和其他费用没算进去，更不是我的实际账单。

如果只想零成本试，别为了这条消息临时开付费层。Google 的例外是科研人员申请：入选后可通过 Antigravity 免费用 Argon 和 Carbon 六个月；按资格、容量和遴选滚动审批，不是人人能领的福利。申请入口在官方公告里。

也不用把现有任务全换成 Carbon。Google 自己说，大多数软件开发和知识工作仍适合 Argon；Carbon 主要留给难度更高、要反复推理和验证的任务。要判断值不值，我会先选一件能核对结果的难任务，用同一份输入分别跑，记下通过的验收项、返工次数和总用量。这个对比我还没做；官方榜单不能代替自己的账。
